label: D2 arrival at S2 after a rewarded trial, early in the episode (high value)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached state shown is S2, and essentially only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 holds 99.9% of mass); never at D1/GO, never on S1 arrivals. Those three conditions give ~100% recall but 9% precision; the feature is strongly restricted to the first ~30 trials of an episode (peak trials 10-19, nearly zero after 40) and to steps where the model value is in its top bin (>8.1), which lifts precision to ~0.44 (dev F1 0.60, mass recall 0.94). Mostly reached via a2-common (82% of mass), but the largest activations are rare a1->S2 transitions after a reward, often with S2 good. Magnitude is mostly small; the early-episode restriction suggests it carries a slow episode-time / drift signal that the predicate captures only coarsely. All variables observed.
